g.title: py_core
g.text: Python-bytecode stack machine (multi-cycle, 2 + operand-byte clocks per instruction)

Values are 34-bit tagged pyval_t (bit 0 = 1: small int, else None / True / False / heap reference). Signal names from py_core.sv. Purple = AXI4-Lite, red = interrupt / trap, dashed = control. State machine: py_core_fsm.svg.

g.title: ctl
g.text: S_EXEC → S_CONST / S_WR / S_RD / S_DONE / S_TRAP

g.title: alu
g.text: ADD SUB AND OR XOR LSHIFT RSHIFT
LT EQ NE GT LE GE → bool (alu_cmp)

g.title: trap
g.text: core stalls; a helper emulates and resumes

g.title: p_axi
g.text: out: m_axil_aw*, w*, ar*, bready, rready
in: m_axil_*ready, b*, r* (AXI4-Lite master, 32-bit address)

g.title: irq->pc
g.text: take_irq (in S_FETCH): rstk[fp] = pc, pc = irq_vec
